title: What If Every Cockroach Vanished? Your Kitchen Is Fine, the Forest Isn't

scenes.text: What if every cockroach vanished tonight? Your kitchen would be fine. The forest would feel it.
Of thousands of species, only about 30 are pests. Most live in the wild, eating dead leaves and rotting wood.
They break down leaf litter, and their waste puts nitrogen into the soil, where trees use it.
Birds, lizards, frogs and small mammals would lose a meal, and mouse and rat numbers would fall too.
Wasps that lay eggs only in cockroach eggs would almost certainly go extinct. About a dozen plants rely on roaches to pollinate them.
Remove only the pest roaches, and the ecosystem barely notices. Remove them all, and the damage builds slowly, forest by forest.

description:
What if every cockroach vanished?
Only about 30 species are pests, while the rest recycle nutrients, feed other animals, and even pollinate. Their loss would hit forests and the animals that depend on them.
